Hint.select: Click selects, double-click opens the sheet. Drag objects and line points. Delete removes.
Hint.object: Click places an object and opens its sheet.
Hint.line: Click adds a point, double-click finishes, right-click removes the last point.
Hint.area: Drag over cells to paint them. Hold Alt to draw a freehand outline.
Hint.erase: Select an area and drag over cells to erase. Hold Alt to cut a freehand outline.

Atlas.name: Atlas: {scene}
Atlas.typesHint: A type's look applies to all its features unless a feature overrides it.
Atlas.layersHint: Areas live on layers. A hidden layer is not drawn for anyone. The top layer in the list is drawn first.
Atlas.removeTypeConfirm: Delete type “{name}”? Its features stay and fall back to the default look.
Atlas.removeLayerConfirm: Delete layer “{name}”? Its areas stay but belong to no layer.
Atlas.lastLayer: At least one layer is required.

Feature.name: Name
Feature.role: Kind of link: capital, source, alliance…
Feature.styleHint: An empty field uses the type's value.

Claims.title: Claims
Claims.draftEmpty: The draft is empty. Everything you change on the map lands here; the GM sees it only after you submit.
Claims.claimTitle: Claim title, e.g. “The hill folk come to the valley”
Claims.claimNote: What you want and why it is possible
Claims.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw the claim? Its changes will be lost.
Claims.hasConflicts: Some changes disagree with the map.
Claims.conflictsText: These changes were made against an older map:
Claims.trustedHint: Claims from trusted players are accepted at once:

Check.speaker: World map
Check.title: Claim check
Check.difficultyHint: As in Vitruvium: 1 is easy, 6 is nearly impossible. Weigh what the world already holds.
Check.noActor: A character is needed: select a token or assign a character to the user.
Check.cardMissing: The check card is not in the chat.

Notify.noAtlas: This scene has no atlas yet. The GM creates it by opening the map.
Notify.featureMissing: The feature is no longer on the map.
Notify.selectAreaToErase: Select the area to erase first.
Notify.updateAvailable: Artarius {latest} is out (you have {current}). To update: return to Foundry setup → Add-on Modules → update button on Artarius.

autoApplyOnSuccess.name: Accept a claim on success
autoApplyOnSuccess.hint: If a claim check succeeds, its changes go on the map at once. The GM decides partial successes and failures.

renderBelowTokens.name: Draw the map below tokens
renderBelowTokens.hint: Experimental. The map sits between the background and tokens instead of above the scene.

checkUpdates.name: Notify about new versions
checkUpdates.hint: The GM sees a message when a new module version is released on GitHub.

Guide.title: Artarius: how to play
Guide.missing: Could not load the guide. It is in the module folder: docs/GUIDE.md.

Quick.findEmpty: The map is empty so far.
Quick.configHint: The eye turns a button on or off, arrows change the order. Every player has their own set.
Quick.defaultSaved: This button set is now the default for all players.

Azgaar.title: Map from Azgaar
Azgaar.gmOnly: Only the GM can import a map.
Azgaar.generateHint: The generator opens inside Foundry. Press “New Map!” until you like the map. Then press “Export”: PNG saves the picture for the background, “Export to JSON” → “Full” saves the data for import.
Azgaar.importHint: States, provinces, burgs, rivers and routes become map features on the current scene. The GM can edit them like any other.
Azgaar.imageHint: PNG or SVG from Azgaar, uploaded to Foundry data
Azgaar.setBackground: Use the picture as scene background and fit the scene size
Azgaar.replace: Replace what an earlier Azgaar import brought
Azgaar.noFile: Choose a JSON file from Azgaar.
Azgaar.done: Import done: states {states}, provinces {provinces}, burgs {burgs}, rivers {rivers}, routes {routes}.

error.notJson: This is not a JSON file.
error.noInfo: The file has no map size. An Azgaar export is needed.
error.notFull: This is not a full export. In Azgaar choose Export to JSON → Full.

Select.hint: Click a hex to see everything on it on the right: zones, marks, lines, their owners, statuses and aspects.

Type.personal: your type, becomes shared once approved
Type.deleteUsed: Type “{name}” is already on the map. Delete it anyway? Items stay but lose the type's look.

Zone.hint: Click or drag to select hexes, Shift to deselect. Alt-click opens a hex. Then attach the hexes to a zone.
Zone.paint: Paint directly: dragging goes straight into the zone
Zone.noCells: Select hexes on the map first.
Zone.nothingToDetach: Selected hexes have no zones on this layer.

Mark.hint: Select hexes by click or drag, pick a mark type and press Place. Each hex gets its own mark.

Line.hint: Click the map to add points. Right-click removes the last point, Esc clears the line. Hold Ctrl to snap to the hex center.
Line.needTwo: A line needs at least two points.

Card.pick: Click a hex with Inspect, or Alt-click.
Card.empty: Nothing here yet. Use Zone, Mark or Line.

Turn.hint: Everyone can draw. Only the current player can submit a claim. The GM passes the turn.
Turn.notYourTurn: It's not your turn. Your draft is kept; submit it on your turn.
Turn.waitFor: It's {name}'s turn. You can submit on your turn.

Queue.title: Claims
Queue.draftHint: Your edits the GM hasn't seen yet
Queue.emptyDraft: Draft is empty. Everything you draw lands here first.
Queue.rejectReason: Why rejected (the player will see it):
